node.title: Re: Is it safe/recommended to use pairs of =cut for multi line comments?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Perl300],

Since the [doc://perlpodspec|specification] says not to begin a POD block with =cut, don't do it! :-) You never know if it might start breaking in a future version of Perl or with a different POD parser.

Update: Also, [doc://podchecker] complains if you start a POD block with =cut.

Personally I'd use =begin comment with =end comment, or =for comment ..., since those are self-documenting.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
